headline: Turkish Sanko Holding to invest $300m in Bangladesh denim factory, create 4,400 jobs
summary: Turkish group Sanko Holding plans to invest $300m in a denim factory in Bangladesh, creating 4,400 jobs. The project has been part of Invest Bangladesh's $1.3 billion pipeline since Q4 2025.
why: Sanko Holding is a Turkish textile group, and foreign direct investment in Bangladesh's garment sector affects export capacity and employment.
